stage: Verified release candidate; live deployment and private QA recorded in the publication receipt.

content_review.main_review: Every shared merge, dependency and substantive change inspected. Approved mapping hashes are in main_review.json.
content_review.source_context: Targeted context reading for consequential changes; not every source reread in full.
content_review.quote_limit: Curly quotations directly followed by citations; normalization of whitespace, case, typographic punctuation, bracketed capitalization and terminal punctuation. Text fidelity only.

semantics: Every real argument tested across every combination of its relevant judged shared claims.
Necessary AND and alternative OR routes, unanswered premises and no automatic acceptance.
Derived answers still require reading; edits preserve direct answers and invalidate affected comparisons.
Persistent bill/value/direction/argument order and prerequisite order.
saving: Complete seven-bill record with long Unicode notes exceeded 1 MB raw JSON; compressed payload saved and recovered exactly.
Save/load/watch, immutable revision backups, sign-out/return, stale edit conflicts and interrupted save recovery.
Authorization, cross-reviewer isolation, unassigned versions denied and atomic revision checks.

browser.layout: No horizontal overflow; context follows content up to cap, internally scrolls for long text; reference person reachable; navigation centered.
browser.controls: Exact Yes/No stems; answers required, notes optional and initially collapsed; direction shown; only Menu; no Main effect, evidence panel, usage list or dependency flag.
browser.summary: All headings/judgments accessible; Both-only strength with Pending, separate omitted-reason fields.

preservation.private_backup: Downloaded to local project history only. No private data in website repository.
preservation.billing: No paid services enabled; no invitations sent.

word_counts.limit: Word counts exclude routed evidence, source lists and optional background. Not a human workload or reliability finding.

limits: Browser viewport emulation and independent test storage contexts, not physical phone or second-device hardware.
Interrupted connection tested with Firebase emulator and save-boundary control.
No new comprehensive external evidence search; evidence gaps remain visible in frozen maps.
ESL clarity has not been tested with human coders.
More definitions increased word count; reduced reading time and reliability gains are not established.
